Hi Aisha / Rohit,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — great call. Summarizing next steps for the ProspectX POC so we have alignment on success criteria, evaluation plan and capacity needs. Please review and confirm ownership/timelines.

POC scope (2 weeks):
- Inference workload: chat + summarization for internal docs (~1k tokens avg)
- Target QPS: 20 steady, with bursts to 60 for demo peaks
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 250ms for single-region requests

Success criteria:
1) Functional parity: model outputs meet the baseline prompts we shared (see sheet)
2) Latency: 95th percentile under 250ms during steady load
3) Cost: projected per-1M-token cost <= $X (will refine after capacity config)
4) Reliability: no more than 1 incident causing >5m downtime during POC

Capacity & infra proposal (initial):
- Reserved GPUs: 2 x A100-equivalent for baseline (dedicated pool)
- Autoscale: allow burst to 6 GPUs for demo periods (scheduled bursts + manual trigger)
- KV/prefix caching enabled for repeated prompts to reduce token compute
- Expected concurrency mapping: ~20 QPS on 2 GPUs with batching; bursts to 60 QPS using autoscale to 6 GPUs

Owner/roles:
- ProspectX: Aisha (POC lead), Rohit (infra contact)
- Redwood: Marissa (commercial lead), Dev Patel (solutions/ops), Jonas Weber (SRE for autoscale config)

Timeline:
- Confirm POC plan & signed trial SLA by EOD Friday (2026-06-19)
- Provision reserved GPUs (Redwood infra) by Monday 6/22
- Kickoff + baseline test 6/23
- POC run 6/24–7/07, mid-point check 6/30

Attachments: attached is the POC requirements sheet with baseline prompts and evaluation rubric.

Please flag any changes; if that looks good I'll loop Dev and Jonas to size the reserved pool and share a DocuSign for the trial SLA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful and matches our internal expectations. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 60 QPS bursts will be mostly during scheduled demos — likely a 15–20 minute window twice during the POC. We can agree schedule windows in the kickoff.
- For success criteria item #3 (cost), could you provide a rough estimate for the 2 GPU reserved + burst setup so we can pre-approve budget?
- Rohit (cc'd) will need the exact networking requirements for private endpoints (we prefer TLS + mTLS to our VPC).

We'll confirm internally and aim to sign the trial SLA by Friday.

Thanks,
Aisha Tan
Head of Product
ProspectX

Appreciate the quick turnaround Aisha — answering your bullets below:

1) Cost estimate (very rough):
- 2 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs (baseline) + Redwood managed infra + storage: ~$9k/week
- Enabling burst up to 6 GPUs for two 20-minute demo windows adds marginal incremental cost (~$600 per burst window) thanks to short duration and autoscale billing granularity
- Final per-1M-token estimate depends on batching and cache hit rate; rough POC projection: $X per 1M tokens (we'll provide a reconciled estimate after we size exact batch configs)

2) Networking: we support TLS + optional mTLS for private deployments; Rohit, Dev will share the network configuration doc and the list of IP ranges and hostname SANs we need.

3) Provisioning: If you sign the trial SLA by EOD Friday, we can provision reserved GPUs by Monday 6/22. We'll schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff to walk through baseline tests and demo schedule.

I've looped Dev (solutions/ops) and Jonas (SRE) to scope the autoscale policy and kick off the provisioning runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks all — I pulled in the provisioning checklist and started a draft autoscale policy. Quick notes from our side (Dev / Jonas):

- Autoscale policy: scale step = +1 GPU each 30s when queue > threshold; max 6 GPUs; cooldown 120s. Scheduled bursts can pre-provision 2 extra GPUs 10 minutes before demo window to avoid startup latency for very short demos.
- KV cache: we recommend a 24-hour TTL for the POC to see benefits across repeated prompts; cache warming plan attached to the drive link.
- Network requirements: we'll provide the VPC peering details and certificate requirements by end of day.

Next actions:
- Marissa: send DocuSign trial SLA (commercial) — target EOD Friday
- Aisha: confirm signoff and demo windows
- Dev/Jonas: finalize autoscale runbook and provisioning ticket once SLA signed

I'll update the shared spreadsheet with exact SKU sizing and cost numbers after the sizing call.

—Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
